what_happened: Discovered that web-research-agent.md/web-implementation-agent.md load context via a static per-agent @-reference list, not via index.json load_when queries -- so the manifest dependency edit alone would not have made 'Astro work auto-load the base TypeScript context' true. Surfaced the concrete fix (one @-pointer line to typescript/README.md in each web agent file) before the plan/implementation phase, avoiding an incomplete-looking-complete deliverable.

validate-artifact.sh rejected Phase 1's first Tier Justification: suite_selection_select collapses a whole multi-path phase to __FULL_SWEEP__ when ANY one path maps to no suite, so naming the six suites that cover index-entries.json alone was a fabricated claim for the phase's path set. Corrected to the sub-case (b) gate subset (--only-gate 3,4 against the repo root); the suite list was kept as an explicitly supplementary check. Plan now validates with 0 warnings.

Phase 1's literal verification grep ('z.discriminatedUnion\|z.coerce.date' returns 0) cannot literally pass: typescript-web.md's retained, Astro-specific 'Content Collection Schemas with Zod' block (explicitly preserved by the plan, not part of the trimmed ### Common Zod Patterns subsection) legitimately contains two z.coerce.date() calls (pubDate/updatedDate). After trimming the generic primitive block and rewording the replacement pointer to avoid adding a third match, the grep returns 2, both traced to the retained block. The actual verification intent (generic Zod primitive block, including z.discriminatedUnion, removed from the Common Zod Patterns subsection) is satisfied: discriminatedUnion has zero occurrences anywhere in the file post-trim. Treating this as satisfied-by-intent since the literal count-of-zero was never achievable without deleting legitimately-retained Astro-specific content the plan explicitly forbids touching.

Phase 1's scoped gate check (verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4) passed gate 3 (doc-lint) but gate 4 (check-task-references.sh) reported 1 finding in agent-system/extensions/core/context/config/orchestrator-context-budget.json -- a committed, unmodified file (last touched by an unrelated prior task's commit chain, git status --short shows it clean) containing a historical task-reference string in its own budget-ceiling derivation log. Not caused by this phase's typescript-web.md/index-entries.json changes; attributed to pre-existing content outside this task's file_scope and left unremediated here.

Phase 3's scoped gate run (verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4,5,6,7) initially failed gate 5 (manifest-driven verification: 'lean: Content differs from source: context/project/lean4/patterns/dependency-tracing.md'), tracing exactly to the pre-existing lean deploy staleness this dispatch's own deploy-freshness-context flagged up front. Per the plan's own named remedy, ran the bounded-wait redeploy (timeout 540 bash .claude/scripts/deploy-headless.sh) and re-ran the scoped gates: gate 5 now passes. Gates 3, 6, 7 (doc-lint, agent-contracts, routing-wiring) pass cleanly -- these are the gates that actually exercise this phase's manifest.json/README.md/EXTENSION.md/agent-file changes. Gate 4 (task-reference lint) still reports the same single pre-existing, unrelated finding in agent-system/extensions/core/context/config/orchestrator-context-budget.json already recorded in an earlier issue this phase. The full redeploy's own 43-gate run additionally surfaced two more pre-existing, unrelated findings (eager-load budget 44 B over its 70,400 B baseline; a test-root-resolution violation in agent-system/extensions/typescript/scripts/tests/test-typescript-verify.sh, a file not in this task's declared file_scope and last touched by a prior task) -- neither is caused by or remediated in this dispatch; both are out of scope for the web->typescript dependency wiring task.
